verdicts.strongest_argument: The headline the finding quotes contains its own refutation: 'INFQ Stock Surges After Three DOE Awards In $5B Genesis Mission - HPE, WLY Also Gain On Joining Federal AI Initiative'. WLY gained on the day. The market saw the announcement, marked the stock up for it, and moved on - which is the plainest possible case of a fact being priced on the date it became known. The item is also published: it is in the admissible stored body at docs/d7ff82564a557ffced5d936a6aa2bd1f37a02219.txt, entry dated 2026-07-22T17:19:31Z, in snapshot 20260830T084039Z, and it concerns a named $5bn federal programme whose awards were a national news story covered across the AI and government-contracting press. A programme of that size and profile does not go unnoticed because a Stocktwits stream has 97 watchers. There is also a measurement error doing real work here. The finding argues 'if the market had paid for it, the twenty-session run-in would not be negative' - but the twenty sessions ending 2026-09-02 begin in early August, roughly a fortnight AFTER 22 July, so the window it cites does not contain the event it is testing. The -6.26% tells us nothing about how 22 July was received; the headline does, and it says the stock rose. Finally, the finding's own independence field concedes that nothing else in the capture points the same way.

verdicts.strongest_argument: Reachable but unconnected, and probably empty. All of it is in filings.json with dates - the 8-K items 5.02/9.01 on 2026-07-09, the Form 3 on 07-17, seven Form 4s on 07-24 and a 144 on 07-02 - so an EDGAR reader had the sequence eight weeks out; no body is stored and nothing in the capture draws it together, which is why I score it in the low thirties rather than either extreme. But the pattern reads mundanely. Item 9.01 means an exhibit was attached, i.e. the change was announced by press release, so it was publicly disseminated at the time. Seven Form 4s filed on a single day is the signature of a scheduled grant or vesting event applying to a whole officer group, not seven new arrivals; the count of genuinely new insiders is one, the Form 3 filer. And a single Form 144 the week before proves nothing without a share count, which the capture does not have. The finding's mechanism - a first print under new leadership is where guidance gets rebased - is a generic heuristic with no size and an unstable sign, and the hunter signs it against its own main finding, which is the right instinct.
